description: Create or update units of measure by abbreviation (max 100 per call, case-insensitive match). name and type (quantity/weight/volume/dimension) are required when creating; updates are preserve-on-omit. isDefault=true moves the default flag. validateOnly=true dry-runs every row. Partial success with per-row errors; resubmitting converges. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential — UoMs are tenant-wide settings. (upsert_items also auto-bootstraps the missing standard UoMs; use this tool for custom units like cases or pallets.)

uoms.description: UoM rows to create/update (max 100). abbreviation is required per row.

abbreviation.description: UoM abbreviation (e.g. "ea", "cs", "kg") — the upsert identity (case-insensitive). Required.

isDefault.description: true makes this the tenant's default UoM (clears the flag on every other UoM).

type.description: UoM type: quantity, weight, volume, or dimension. Required when creating; preserve-on-omit on update.

validateOnly.description: true = dry-run: validate + probe every row and report the would-be action per row, writing nothing.

name: upsert_uoms
title: Upsert Units of Measure
